items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Because they wanted me, because Leonard Harper had spoke to me about playing this show on Broadway.

ctx.x: So in other words when Louis was there in Hot Chocolates, there was no question of you stealing the limelight from him in any way?

No, no, but he wouldn't let them bring me down to play the Broadway show, he wanted me to stay in Connie's Inn to take care of the band. One of those things. You know what I mean? Because they wanted me, because Leonard Harper had spoke to me about playing this show on Broadway.
Well when you said the show on Broadway, Louis didn't go to the show on Broadway?
